name: boctulus/simplerest-api-clients
description: Optional Google Drive, WooCommerce, OneSignal, Hugging Face, Pastebin, and SendinBlue clients for SimpleRest

suggest.google/apiclient: Required only when using GoogleDrive; the integration reports a clear error until the SDK is installed.
suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Required only when using the SendinBlue transactional email adapter.
